summary: Fresh full suite for the SDK review fixes: URP with the Solana rulebook moved into the linked SvmRulebook library, EVM argument pins, zero-means-nothing limits; AGW with gateway auto-approve and createWallet; AGWFactory with createWallet / createWalletWithSig. Engine and validator are fresh too, bytecode-identical to v4/v5.

factoryProxy.note: PERMANENT, user-facing: deploy and look up wallets here. Also the EIP-712 verifyingContract for every OwnerIntent.

factoryLogic.note: Adds createWallet(label, rules) and createWalletWithSig(intent, sig, label, rules) (selector 0x0a8f332b).

walletImplementation.note: Clone target; accountId push.agw.1.0.0. Gateway auto-approve on both doors; initializeAccount(string label, Session[] rules).

urp.note: PERMANENT: every v6 wallet pins it; every rule names it as its only action policy.

svmRulebook.note: Deployed by forge through the CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C. Blockscout does not index the internal creation, reports the address as not a contract, and refuses verification. The code is on chain (eth_getCode) and is embedded in urpImplementation.

urpProxyAdmin.note: KEEP: no URP upgrade is possible without it. Created internally by the TUP; read from the ERC-1967 admin slot.

adminState.note: Testnet: the factory's default admin and the URP ProxyAdmin owner are both the deployer EOA. PAUSER_ROLE and OPERATOR_ROLE are unassigned; grant them before the factory can be paused.

ruleEncoding.initData: abi.encode(uint16 version, string chainNamespace, bytes body), version 1
ruleEncoding.argPinTuple: (uint16,uint8,bytes32) — offset (selector included, 4 = first argument), op (0 = EQ, 1 = MAX), value
ruleEncoding.tokens: PRC20 addresses on Push, 1..8 per cross-chain rule; type(uint256).max = unlimited, 0 = nothing
ruleEncoding.maxCalls: native rules: 0 is refused (ZeroMaxCalls); type(uint32).max = unlimited
ruleEncoding.maxAccounts: Solana programs: 1..64 exact; 255 = any count; 0 and 65..254 refused
ruleEncoding.approvals: none needed: the wallet approves the gateway for exactly the outbound amount and clears the allowance after the call

createWallet.signedForm: createWalletWithSig: intent.sessionHash == keccak256(abi.encode(rules)) and intent.grantNonce == 0; the label is not signed

supersedes.note: v5 and v4 wallets keep working against the v4 URP and engine, which stay live; they do not get v6 behaviour. The v5 book is kept beside this one in deployments/address-book-v5/.
